description: This Java source file defines the AccountTransferAssembler class, which contains methods for assembling account transfer details between savings accounts and loans within the Finfiteract project. It handles various transfer scenarios such as savings-to-savings, savings-to-loan, loan-to-savings, and loan-to-loan transfers, constructing corresponding transfer details and transactions.

classes.name: AccountTransferAssembler
classes.description: Service class responsible for assembling account transfer details and transactions for various transfer scenarios within the account management module.

methods.description: Assembles transfer details for savings-to-savings account transfer, including creating an account transfer transaction with specified amount, date, and description.
